name: Canals (Stormwind City)
summary: Stormwind's Canals wind between the city's districts, where walkers and anglers share the waterside paths.

sections.title: Arteries of the Capital
sections.body: You can follow the Canals between Stormwind's districts, from the Trade District's markets to Old Town's aged alleys, the cathedral gardens, and the Dwarven District. Stone bridges, archways, and waterside walks pass the Gallina Winery, tailor shops, and quiet homes. Merchants and fishermen use the waterways, while the fortified Stockade entrance lies beneath the streets, holding Stormwind's most dangerous criminals and rebels.

sections.title: A Gruesome History and Lurking Shadows
sections.body: Stormwind's Canals were left in ruins when the Horde sacked the city during the First War. The waterways were restored as the capital rose again after the Second War. They are clean and repaired now, though rumors speak of a massive albino crocolisk beneath the docks.

faq.q: What happened to the canals during the First War?
faq.answer: The Horde sacked Stormwind during the First War, leaving the city and its waterways in ruins. The Canals were restored when the capital was rebuilt after the Second War.

faq.q: Is there really a monster in the Stormwind canals?
faq.answer: No one can say for certain. Rumors tell of a massive white crocolisk lurking in the waterways, though guards and residents often dismiss the tales as tavern gossip. Reports continue, and adventurers are warned not to fall in.

faq.q: Where is the entrance to the Stockade located?
faq.answer: The Stockade entrance lies along the northernmost stretch of the canal around the Mage Quarter, guarded by the Stormwind City Guard.

faq.q: Can players swim through the canals to travel around Stormwind?
faq.answer: You can swim through the Canals, then find stone stairs or docks along the waterside paths to climb back to the street.

angles.text: As an aspiring cook, you can fish along the quiet canal banks without leaving the safety of the capital's walls.
As an Alliance member, you can see how the Canals were restored after the First War's ruins, as Stormwind became a working, picturesque city.
